priorFallbackHypothesisFailurePreserved.origin: Exact observed tool-console error text copied into artifact, not an original automatic child capture.

rejection.reason: All-percentiles median regresses against baseline with overlapping observed ranges; all-calculations and small-standard medians also remain slower. Three isolated p95 workloads improve with disjoint ranges, but that does not establish whole-candidate nonregression or authorize integration.

limitations: Seven repetitions on one Windows Node24 host; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
Timing children load all three implementations for common prevalidation; memory diagnostics from those children are not isolated.
Memory children load exactly one implementation and authenticate its native two-module graph or original six CJS files.
100ms observer and checkpoint RSS can miss intermediate peaks; lifetime maxRSS measures the complete child, not only reduction.

Release diagnostics include both releasedAfterGC-minus-beforeRetention (historical comparable) and releasedAfterGC-minus-warmBase (prospective plan). Retained/released signed deltas include GC variation and common serializer/cache-read validation pressure; negative values are preserved without clipping and are not a leak proof.
256MiB old-space and512MiB observed RSS do not establish an OS process memory sandbox or cumulative allocations.
Observer numeric PID matches each owned child result, but there is no process-start identity proof or atomic PID-reuse/process-tree protection. Memory controller has no outer watchdog.
Current metrics production and older source/receipts remain unchanged; no new measured run, tuning, integration or publication was performed.
